description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.
The region ID of the instance.

description.zh:
唯一指定用户创建的Data API账号的登录凭证及权限。
格式如下：```acs:gpdb:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:secret/{{secretName}}-{{32 digits random string}```。

> 和SecretName参数二选一。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the access credential for the created Data API account. Format: `acs:gpdb:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:secret/{{secretName}}-{{32 digits random string}`.

>  You must specify one of the SecretArn and SecretName parameters.

description.zh:
用户凭证名称。

> 和SecretArn参数二选一。
description.en:
The name of the access credential.

>  You must specify one of the SecretArn and SecretName parameters.

description.zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准。
description.en: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances. You must specify one of the WorkspaceId and DBInstanceId parameters. If you specify both parameters, the WorkspaceId parameter takes effect.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb get-secret-value --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --workspace-id gp-ws-00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --secret-arn acs:gpdb:cn-beijing:103300:secret/testsecret-eG2AQGRIwQ0zFp4VA7mYL3uiCXTfDQbQ --secret-name testsecret --region cn-hangzhou
